svg.title: SnowBall credits — Borrowed with thanks
svg.desc: Leaves is the server base. Leaf contributed fast paths and fixes, and inspired bounded asynchronous pathfinding. EtheriumMC inspired independent experimental culling and sensor sorting. Of 20 reviewed mods, 9 were ported, 3 are covered upstream, 5 were not ported and 3 are deferred. Ports include BiomeSpy 26.1 by MoePus for biome locate and column sampling. Yamada0001/SnowBall, by Yamada0001. See the README for source links.

g.title: Leaves (LeavesMC) — github.com/LeavesMC/Leaves. Vanilla-mechanics fixes, fake players and optional server optimizations.
Leaf (LeafMC) — github.com/Winds-Studio/Leaf. Event and advancement fast paths, chunk packets and spawn tuning; skeleton-horse trap and End fixes; separate bounded async pathfinding.
EtheriumMC — github.com/deivaxxx/EtheriumMC. Independent experiments: raytrace entity culling and parallel distance sorting for two sensors. No upstream code copied.
mcm-rabbit-pathfinding-fix — github.com/litetex-oss/mcm-rabbit-pathfinding-fix. Path timeout fix for mobs at zero speed.
StructureLayoutOptimizer — github.com/TelepathicGrunt/StructureLayoutOptimizer. Jigsaw octree + template-pool dedup.
Bellows — github.com/Smithed-MC/Bellows. Filtered NBT, selector index, display culling bypass.
RailOptimization — github.com/EasterGhost/RailOptimization. Faster powered-rail updates; adjustable range.
FerriteCore — github.com/malte0811/FerriteCore. Shared block-state data and empty component maps.
Oushii — github.com/Paulem79/Oushii. Grid-based explosions and same-tick TNT merging.
ModernFix — github.com/embeddedt/ModernFix. Shape/parameter dedup, DFU cleanup, stronghold cache.
Cerulean — github.com/noramibu/Cerulean. Inventory advancement trigger throttling.
BiomeSpy — github.com/MoePus/BiomeSpy (26.1). Biome locate / column sampling.
alternate-current — github.com/SpaceWalkerRS/alternate-current. Paper already includes AC redstone.
ScalableLux — github.com/RelativityMC/ScalableLux. Paper already has Starlight lighting.
PacketFixer — github.com/TonimatasDEV/PacketFixer. Packet limit changes largely overlap.
krypton — github.com/astei/krypton. Native networking stack not imported.
Ksyxis — github.com/VidTu/Ksyxis. Spawn-chunk mechanism removed.
AsyncLogger — github.com/decce6/AsyncLogger. Log4j2 config instead of a port.
Jasione — github.com/decce6/Jasione. Requires a Mixin processor hook.
InfChatHistory — github.com/xBackpack/InfChatHistory. Client-only chat history.
worldthreader — github.com/2No2Name/worldthreader. Dimension-level tick threading.
Async — github.com/AxalotLDev/Async. Parallel entity ticking.
Ferrite — github.com/VoiceLessQ/Ferrite. Rust/JNI worldgen and tick optimizations.
